result.title: Real Pairs Are Not Enough: Physically Anchored Supervision for Volumetric CT Super-Resolution
result.summary: Volumetric CT super-resolution (SR) models are commonly trained on synthetic or physically acquired pairs of low-resolution (LR) and high-resolution (HR) volumes. However, synthetic pairs miss real acquisition effects, whereas registered physical pairs retain inter-scan noise, artifact, and microstructure differences---causing direct voxelwise regression, and even naive synthetic-real mixing, to oversmooth fine porous structures. We introduce the Physically-anchored Implicit Network (PIN) with Real-Pair Dual-Anchor learning, which decouples physical-pair supervision into two complementary roles. The HR anchor teaches fine structure from registered HR through pair-conditioned spectral replay, while the LR anchor constrains the prediction from acquired LR via affine-calibrated low-pass projection. Together with exact synthetic supervision in one shared volumetric implicit model, PIN learns from both physical scans without forcing the acquired-LR reconstruction to match registered HR voxel by voxel. Inference requires only acquired LR. Across 30 external baseline configurations on real CT, PIN achieves the lowest full-volume LPIPS, reduces average symmetric surface distance by 42.3-49.5% and bone-volume-fraction error by 52.2-53.4% relative to the three strongest baselines for each metric, and lowers the erased reference-pore volume fraction from 37.3-72.9% to 10.4%. Code, pretrained models, and evaluation scripts will be publicly available.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究体数据 CT 超分辨，提出隐式网络 PIN 与「真实配对双锚」学习：将物理配对监督拆为 HR 锚（配对条件频谱回放）与 LR 锚（仿射校准低通投影），并与合成精确监督共享同一隐式体模型，以避免逐体素回归把细孔结构过度平滑。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把监督拆成保细节与约束预测两路、并以频谱/低通先验防止过平滑的做法，可能为 LVR 中避免视觉细节在 latent 状态里塌缩、以及不完全对齐的轨迹监督提供线索；但任务与模态相距较远，可供核查而非直接迁移。
